quests.instruction: Which of these is b?
quests.hint: Sing the alphabet song and stop at 'bee'. Which shape do you picture?
quests.explanation: b: a tall stick on the left with a round tummy on the right. A word to remember it by: Bread.
quests.funFact: A bee, a bear and a ball all begin with B.

quests.instruction: Spot d among the look-alikes.
quests.hint: Sing the alphabet song and stop at 'dee'. Which shape do you picture?
quests.explanation: d is easy to spot once you know its shape: a round tummy on the left with a tall stick on the right. A word to remember it by: Dolphin.
quests.funFact: The letters 'ed' at the end of a word often show something already happened, like jumped.

quests.instruction: Which small letter has the shape of a tall stick on the left with a round tummy on the right?
quests.hint: Trace the shape slowly with your finger, then say the letter name.
quests.explanation: b is a tall stick on the left with a round tummy on the right. k is different: a tall stick with a small arrow on its right.
quests.funFact: The letters x, v, w and z are made only of straight lines.

quests.instruction: Which small letter looks like a round tummy on the left with a tall stick on the right?
quests.hint: Draw the shape in the air, then compare it with each letter.
quests.explanation: d is a round tummy on the left with a tall stick on the right. g is different: a circle with a tail that curves below the line.
quests.funFact: Lowercase p and q are mirror twins that hang below the line.

quests.instruction: Find the word moon.
quests.hint: These words look alike. Check the letter that is different in each one.
quests.explanation: moon is spelled m-o-o-n. The other words use n and s in the same spot.
quests.funFact: Lowercase b and d are mirror images, so they are easy to mix up when you are learning.

quests.instruction: One letter in this row does not belong: R B R R R. Which one is it?
quests.hint: Scan the row from left to right. Which letter appears only once?
quests.explanation: B is the odd one. All the others are R.
quests.funFact: Reading gets faster when your eyes learn to notice small differences, like a dot or a curve.

quests.instruction: Slow down and find p.
quests.hint: Sing the alphabet song and stop at 'pee'. Which shape do you picture?
quests.explanation: That is p. Its name is 'pee', and you can see it at the start of Parrot.
quests.funFact: The name 'pee' rhymes with tree and sea.

quests.instruction: Look closely. Which one is q?
quests.hint: Sing the alphabet song and stop at 'cue'. Which shape do you picture?
quests.explanation: q is the letter named 'cue'. Its shape: a round tummy on the left with a stick hanging below the line on the right.
quests.funFact: Q is letter number 17 of the 26 letters, with 16 letters before it and 9 after it.

quests.instruction: Which word says bed?
quests.hint: Spell bed out loud: b-e-d. Find that spelling.
quests.explanation: bed is spelled b-e-d. The other words use r and w in the same spot.
quests.funFact: In some fonts, capital I and lowercase l look alike, so the rest of the word helps you decide.

quests.instruction: Find the small letter that is a stick hanging below the line with a round tummy at the top right.
quests.hint: Look for the biggest difference between the choices: a stick, a curve, a dot or a tail.
quests.explanation: p is a stick hanging below the line with a round tummy at the top right. n is different: a short line with one hump.
quests.funFact: The letters with tails that hang below the line are g, j, p, q and y.

quests.instruction: Look at the row: g g p g g g. Which letter is different from the others?
quests.hint: Compare each letter with the one next to it. Where does the pattern change?
quests.explanation: p is the odd one. All the others are g.
quests.funFact: The tall letters are b, d, f, h, k, l and t.

quests.instruction: Match the capital P with its small letter.
quests.hint: Imagine writing Pencil in small letters. What is its first letter?
quests.explanation: Capital P, small p. Compare Pencil and pencil.
quests.funFact: Days and months begin with capital letters in English, like Monday and March.

quests.instruction: Which one is exactly m, and not a look-alike?
quests.hint: Sing the alphabet song and stop at 'em'. Which shape do you picture?
quests.explanation: That is m. Its name is 'em', and you can see it at the start of Magnet.
quests.funFact: Capital M looks like two mountain peaks.

quests.instruction: Slow down and find n.
quests.hint: Sing the alphabet song and stop at 'en'. Which shape do you picture?
quests.explanation: n: a short line with one hump.
quests.funFact: When n and g come together, as in ring and song, they make one sound.

quests.instruction: Which small letter has the shape of a short line with two humps?
quests.hint: Picture the word Milk: its first letter has this shape.
quests.explanation: m is a short line with two humps. w is different: two small V shapes side by side.
quests.funFact: Only i and j have a dot on top.

quests.instruction: Which one is rice? Look at the letters closely.
quests.hint: Look closely at the letter that changes. rice has r: a short stick with a little curl at the top.
quests.explanation: rice is spelled r-i-c-e. The other words use m and n in the same spot.
quests.funFact: Letters that look alike are the ones to slow down for, such as b and d, or u and v.

quests.instruction: Which small letter looks like a short line with one hump?
quests.hint: Draw the shape in the air, then compare it with each letter.
quests.explanation: n is a short line with one hump. m is different: a short line with two humps.
quests.funFact: N is the first letter in the second half of the alphabet.

quests.instruction: Look at the row: V V V V M. Which letter is different from the others?
quests.hint: Compare each letter with the one next to it. Where does the pattern change?
quests.explanation: M is the odd one. All the others are V.
quests.funFact: Lowercase m has two humps, and n has one.

quests.instruction: Which one is exactly u, and not a look-alike?
quests.hint: Sing the alphabet song and stop at 'you'. Which shape do you picture?
quests.explanation: u is easy to spot once you know its shape: a small cup open at the top. A word to remember it by: Umbrella.
quests.funFact: In blue and glue, the letters 'ue' say 'oo'.

quests.instruction: Look closely. Which one is v?
quests.hint: Sing the alphabet song and stop at 'vee'. Which shape do you picture?
quests.explanation: v is the letter named 'vee'. Its shape: a small V. A word to remember it by: Vest.
quests.funFact: Lowercase v has the same shape as capital V, only smaller.

quests.instruction: Which word says mail?
quests.hint: These words look alike. Check the letter that is different in each one.
quests.explanation: mail is spelled m-a-i-l. The other words use n and t in the same spot.
quests.funFact: A to M is the first half of the alphabet, and M is the last letter in that half.

quests.instruction: Find the small letter that is a small cup open at the top.
quests.hint: Picture the word UFO: its first letter has this shape.
quests.explanation: u is a small cup open at the top. w is different: two small V shapes side by side.
quests.funFact: The word 'you' sounds just like the letter name U.

quests.instruction: Find the word that uses y and u together.
quests.hint: Check each word for the first letter, then for the second.
quests.explanation: ladybug is spelled l-a-d-y-b-u-g, so it has both y and u. trophy has only y, and drum has only u.
quests.funFact: Lowercase y has a tail that hangs below the line.

quests.instruction: Count the letter N: N M M M M M N M. How many are there?
quests.hint: Point to each one as you count so you do not skip any.
quests.explanation: There are 2 of the letter N in the row. The other letters are M.
quests.funFact: N and M both hum through your nose.

quests.instruction: Which of these is i?
quests.hint: Sing the alphabet song and stop at 'eye'. Which shape do you picture?
quests.explanation: i is easy to spot once you know its shape: a short line with a dot on top.
quests.funFact: In light and night, the letters 'igh' say 'eye'.

quests.instruction: Spot l among the look-alikes.
quests.hint: Its name is 'ell'. Think of Leg: which letter does it begin with?
quests.explanation: l: one tall, straight line.
quests.funFact: Ladder, lamp and leaf all begin with L.

quests.instruction: Which small letter has the shape of a short line with a dot on top?
quests.hint: Look for the biggest difference between the choices: a stick, a curve, a dot or a tail.
quests.explanation: i is a short line with a dot on top. h is different: a tall stick with one hump on the right.
quests.funFact: I is a vowel. It can say 'ih' as in pig, or 'eye' as in bike.

quests.instruction: Find the small letter that is one tall, straight line.
quests.hint: Trace the shape slowly with your finger, then say the letter name.
quests.explanation: l is one tall, straight line. h is different: a tall stick with one hump on the right.
quests.funFact: The name of L is 'ell'.

quests.instruction: Find the word that uses the letter z.
quests.hint: The letter z can be at the start, the middle or the end.
quests.explanation: lizard is spelled l-i-z-a-r-d, so it has z. rain and basket do not.
quests.funFact: Zebra, zero and zoo all begin with Z.

quests.instruction: Look at the row: f f f f i f f. Which letter is different from the others?
quests.hint: Compare each letter with the one next to it. Where does the pattern change?
quests.explanation: i is the odd one. All the others are f.
quests.funFact: I is letter number 9 of the 26 letters, with 8 letters before it and 17 after it.
